summary: Automatic Assessment Configuration starts a locked exam session, limiting desktop features. It needs an Apple-issued entitlement granted to educational apps on Apple's platforms. BifrOSt has no assessment or exam lockdown mode, and the feature is tied to Apple's entitlement process.

features.note: Needs the Apple com.apple.developer.automatic-assessment-configuration entitlement, granted through Apple's request form
The sandbox isolates apps but is not an exam lockdown; no exam allow-list API

features.feature: Menu bar items kept during assessment
features.note: The menu bar has no assessment mode; the framework's structures have no counterpart
Apple account types; no exam account role
